phone.login: Phone app login: username is the PHONE NUMBER from supervisor.show_profile (not the email; email gives 401). Password from show_account_passwords. login_all() handles this.
phone.get_current_date_and_time: Takes NO arguments. Returns {'date': 'Thursday, May 18, 2023', 'time': '12:00 PM'}, not ISO. Use phone_now() / parse_dt().
phone.search_contacts: PAGED (default 5 per page): use get_all(..., query='', relationship='roommate'); one raw call returns only 5 contacts. Fields: first_name, last_name (no 'name'), email, phone_number, relationships (list). Same first names are common: filter with contacts_matching().
phone.show_alarms: Items: alarm_id, time 'HH:MM', repeat_days, label, enabled. Label can be null. Page limit max 20; use get_all().
phone.delete_text_message: Collect ALL message ids first, then delete; deleting while paging skips items.
spotify.show_song: No access_token parameter (error if passed). Gives release_date, genre (single string), play_count, rating, like_count, artists, and duration in SECONDS (not duration_ms). Use for per-song facts.
spotify.show_album: No access_token. Returns 'songs' (entries id, title, artists) - there is NO 'song_ids' key here (that exists only on library items). ids_from([album]) gets the song ids.
spotify.show_playlist: Needs access_token for private playlists (422 without); no paging. 'songs' entries have id, title, album_id, artists - there is NO 'song_ids' key here. ids_from([playlist]) gets the song ids.
spotify.show_song_privates: Only returns liked, reviewed, in_song_library, downloaded flags. No play_count/genre here.
spotify.review_song: Returns 409 if you already reviewed the song; then use update_song_review(review_id=...) instead.
spotify.show_song_library: Page limit max 20. Items: song_id, title, album_id, artists, added_at. 'All my songs' also includes song_ids of library albums and playlists; union with ids_from(). A per-song fact such as release_date comes from show_song, not from the album.
file_system.show_directory: Params: directory_path, substring, entry_type ('all','files' or 'directories'; plural), recursive. Returns absolute path STRINGS (dirs end '/'); NO paging. List recursively and print the tree before moving, zipping or deleting.
file_system.show_file: Param is file_path. Returns dict with file_id, path, content, created_at, updated_at.
file_system.move_file: Params: source_file_path, destination_file_path, retain_dates, overwrite. Use retain_dates=True for plain renames/moves so created/updated dates are kept. Create the destination folder first. Compute every final path once; do not re-run the batch.
venmo.search_users: Matches name or email only, NEVER a phone number (a phone query returns arbitrary users). For a phone number find the phone contact (by_field on phone_number) and use its email. Fuzzy: compare the exact email with by_field().
venmo.show_transactions: Filters: user_email, min/max_created_at as 'YYYY-MM-DD', min/max_amount. Items have sender{name,email}, receiver{name,email}, amount, description, created_at and NO 'direction'/'liked': use tx_with(txs, my_email, emails) to get sent/received. Use get_all(). 'From X' = received from X; 'to X' = sent to X.
supervisor.complete_task: Question tasks: pass answer=<minimal value>. Action tasks (anything that just changes state): call with NO answer; an unexpected answer fails the task. If an earlier step errored or found nothing, fix that first - do not complete.
spotify.search_songs: Fuzzy text search: a query with an artist name returns other artists' songs. For one artist's songs use songs_of_artist(apis,'spotify','search_songs',artist_id). Also filters genre, min/max_*; sort_by '-play_count' / '-rating' / '+like_count' (+/- prefix required).
spotify.search_artists: Takes NO access_token. Filters: query (name), genre= (exact genre string; use it for 'reggae artists'), min/max_follower_count, sort_by. Paged: use get_all(). Artist ids feed songs_of_artist / search_songs(artist_id=). Check each result's 'genre' before bulk follows.
spotify.show_song_queue: Needs access_token. Entries: song_id, title, position, is_playing, is_current, duration (seconds). 'Played so far' = entries BEFORE the current one; use queue_split(queue). Never act on the whole queue unless asked.
spotify.show_song_reviews: No access_token parameter. Filter by user_email= to get one user's review; the average is show_song 'rating'. Items: song_review_id, rating, title, text, user{name,email}. 'My rating' = my own review, not the average.
spotify.update_song_review: Params: review_id, rating, title, text (no 'comment'). review_song takes song_id, rating, title, text. Do not review twice (409): look up the existing review id first.
spotify.show_album_library: Items carry album_id, title, song_ids (page limit 20; use get_all()). For 'songs in my library' use show_song_library alone; add songs of library albums/playlists (ids_from) only when the task says 'all my songs'.
file_system.compress_directory: Params: directory_path, compressed_file_path (.zip), delete_directory, overwrite. Zip only the folders the task names, never into themselves. The named folders may sit one level down: print the recursive tree (entry_type='all') first.
phone.search_text_messages: Items: text_message_id (not message_id), message, sender{name,phone_number}, receiver{...}, sent_at. 'query' is fuzzy: filter with phone_number=. sort_by only '+created_at'/'-created_at'. Read the message that holds the request before acting.
phone.send_text_message: Params: phone_number, message (not 'content'), access_token. The message must contain only what was asked (e.g. only the matching items), not everything you found.
simple_note.search_notes: Items: note_id, title, content, tags, pinned. Use note_id with show_note/update_note. To tick a checklist item edit the content text ([ ] -> [x], see replace_line) and leave title/tags/pinned unchanged.
venmo.show_sent_payment_requests: Requests I SENT (receiver is who owes me); show_received_payment_requests = requests sent TO me. Items: payment_request_id, amount, description, created_at, approved_at, denied_at, sender{}, receiver{} (no 'status'/'recipient'). Use get_all().
venmo.show_social_feed: Transactions of OTHER people (friends) - not my own: items have sender{name,email}, receiver{name,email}, amount, description, created_at. Paged; use get_all(). Use it when the task says 'on my feed'; filter by exact email.
venmo.create_transaction: Pays from the Venmo balance unless payment_card_id is given. Use pay_any_funding(...): tries balance then each card, skips expired / too-poor ones, never tops up (a top-up changes extra state and fails). No audience arg: private=True or omit. Only pay what was asked.
spotify.play_music: At most ONE of song_id / album_id / playlist_id / queue_position per call. To play a song FROM an album/playlist use play_from(...) (starts the collection, then plays the song's queue_position). Plain 'play song X' = song_id. Never guess API names; check show_api_descriptions.
venmo.create_transaction_comment: Params: transaction_id, comment (not 'text'/'description'), access_token. Comment on the right transaction: print its sender, receiver, amount, description first.
venmo.create_payment_request: Params: user_email, amount, description, access_token. The description must be exactly the text asked for. Amount = bill total / (people sharing, INCLUDING me) when it is 'shared equally'. Request from every matching person, from get_all contacts.
supervisor.show_payment_cards: Cards have expiry_year and expiry_month (ints), card_name, last_four_digits, id. Never add, delete or change cards or top up a balance unless the task literally says so; if one card fails, try another existing card.
spotify.delete_account: Deletes the WHOLE account of the app it is called on. Only call it on the app the task names, after checking that app's name, and never for another app.
spotify.show_liked_songs: Items are liked songs: song_id, title, artists[{id,name}], ... Artist ids: artist_ids_of(items) (ids_from gives SONG ids). Print the id set and sample names before follow/unfollow style bulk changes.
spotify.show_downloaded_songs: Paged; use get_all(). Downloaded status comes from this list or show_song_privates. Print one item's keys before reading ids.
spotify.show_recommendations: 'Recommended songs' means this API's result (my recommendations), not search_songs or the library. Get all pages with get_all().
file_system.create_file: Params: file_path, content, access_token, overwrite. For CSV content use csv_text(header, rows): it quotes only fields that need it. Separate multiple artists with the separator the task names. Verify with show_file.
spotify.clear_song_queue: Wipes the WHOLE queue including songs that were there before the task. Do not use it to fix a mistake; the checker expects old queue + the new songs.
